column1: # Scene labels for the SigLIP 2 labeller (vb-onnx/src/labels.rs), in the
# order of the rows of scene-labels.f32, which scripts/make-scene-labels.sh
# makes from this file. Edit here, run the script, commit both.
# label: what a description says, in English as Apple Vision's labels are.
# zh: the same in Chinese. kind: place, subject or activity -- one of each at
# most is said about a picture. The last column is what the prompt names:
# "this is a photo of <it>.", and for places and subjects also "this is a
# photo with <it> in the background.", averaged.
# Chosen for family and travel footage, and checked against 92 frames of two
# real sets (a Xinjiang trip, a baby's first year) looked at one by one.
